# Nob

`nob.h` is the unmodified v3.8.2 header from the local Toy project's
`deps/nob/nob.h`, originally from <https://github.com/tsoding/nob.h>.
Its license and attribution are included in the header.

This is a vendored copy: building matmul does not depend on the Toy checkout
and does not download build code. `nob.c` uses it to run the CMake/CTest workflow.
